summary: Five qualifying multifamily sales comps (96–125 units) within 1.72 miles and dated between 2026-02-05 and 2026-06-09 were selected: R5709, R1935 (amended consideration via U-R1935-1), R8685, R1029, and R4639. All are closed, stabilized, single-asset, fee-simple, unrelated-party transactions with known positive consideration and property sizes within 78–174 units. Other nearby 2026 records were excluded for reasons including wrong size unit (acre), out-of-range unit count, minority interest, missing price, listing/portfolio/unrelated scope, redevelopment, related-party, or publication after the 2026-08-31 cutoff.
limitations: One qualifying sale (R4014) was excluded solely due to publication after the 2026-08-31 cutoff despite an in-window closing date.
Where two sources referenced the same sale (R5709 and R4477), deduplication relied on matching entity_id and event details; alternative duplicates not evident in the packet may persist.
Price per unit is a direct normalization (no quality/age/location adjustments) and depends on reported unit counts and considerations.
Records with null consideration (e.g., R3929) or non-unit size reporting (e.g., R3713) could not be rehabilitated without additional evidence.
